title: AdmissionContext
description: What admission knows about the package and the Hub.

kinds.description: The kinds that the package may watch (UI-BD-2). A kind that is not listed is not admitted.

package.description: The key of the package that the document belongs to (UI-AD-4, UI-EM-12).

views.description: The ids of the package's views (UI-SL-5).

supported_majors.description: The MAJOR versions that the Hub supports (UI-VR-3).

features.description: The feature names that the Hub knows (UI-VR-4).

KindDescriptor.description: The Hub's descriptor of a kind, as admission reads it (UI-AD-1, Hub to client DS-1).

owner.description: The package that owns the kind, when it is not a Hub kind (UI-EM-12).

field_types.description: The JSON type of a field, by path, when the kind's schema states it (UI-FM-1, UI-AD-3).

HandlerDescriptor.description: A registered `ui_action` handler and its canonical schema (UI-FM-1).
